payload.title: Title: fgos approve: dirty tracked .fgos/* in main checkout makes git merge abort before…
payload.description:
Title: fgos approve: dirty tracked .fgos/* in main checkout makes git merge abort before MERGE_HEAD, bypassing ADR0020 self-heal/reject logic

Status: todo

Severity: P1

Description:

fgos approve vẫn có một pre-merge failure class chưa được xử lý: nếu shared main checkout đang có local tracked changes dưới .fgos/*, và worker branch cũng có version tracked/stale của đúng path đó, git merge --no-commit --no-ff <branch> abort ngay với:

error: Your local changes to the following files would be overwritten by merge:
        .fgos/events/<writer>.jsonl
        .fgos/config.json
Aborting

Trong shape này Git không tạo MERGE_HEAD, nên code không đi vào resolveFgosOnlyConflict(...). Kết quả bị classify thành merge-failed-unclassified, dù đây là cùng họ ADR0020 .fgos divergence mà approve/catchup đáng ra phải tự xử lý hoặc block bằng reason riêng có cấu trúc.

Evidence:

- approve deliberately ignores dirty .fgos/ in the clean-tree gate: isWorkingTreeClean(... ownFileSet) treats .fgos/ as ignorable.
- But mergeRunnerItemLocked later calls raw git merge while those tracked .fgos/* changes are still dirty.
- Existing self-heal only runs after mergeHeadExists(repoRoot) is true.
- Existing sweep of .fgos/events/ happens after the merge has already succeeded, so it is too late for this failure mode.

Relevant code:

- src/verbs/merge/approve.mjs: root approve clean-tree gate calls isMainTreeClean(repoRoot, ownFileSet) before merge.
- src/runner/merge.mjs: isFgosOnlyStatusLine ignores .fgos/.
- src/runner/merge.mjs: git merge --no-commit --no-ff branch can abort before MERGE_HEAD.
- src/runner/merge.mjs: resolveFgosOnlyConflict only runs when MERGE_HEAD exists.
- src/runner/merge.mjs: dirty .fgos/events sweep is post-merge.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Add regression test where main has dirty tracked .fgos/events/<writer>.jsonl and branch has stale/different tracked same shard. approve/mergeRunnerItem must not return generic merge-failed-unclassified.
2. Add regression test where main has dirty tracked .fgos/config.json and branch carries stale tracked .fgos/config.json; expected behavior must be explicit.
3. Fix should happen before raw git merge, or by moving live .fgos event state out of tracked merge surface.
4. If the path is append-only event shard, preserve main/live event data.
5. If path is non-append-only .fgos/config.json, do not silently discard real branch-authored config edits; either prove branch path unchanged since branchHeadAtTake and keep target, or block with structured ADR0020 reason.
6. Result must be structured, not raw merge-failed-unclassified with Git stderr only.

Blocked by / related:

- Related to tsk-tr9, but not fully covered by it because tsk-tr9 handles conflicts after merge starts. This item covers the earlier "Git refuses before MERGE_HEAD" class.
- Related to tsk-4uv because dirty live event shards are one trigger.
- Related to tsk-5rg because tsk-5rg's repro path independently hits the same pre-MERGE_HEAD dirty-.fgos trigger (merge-failed-unclassified) before its own downstream CAS symptom.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.title: Title: truncation guard detects event-log regression but fail-opens, allowing…
payload.description:
Title: truncation guard detects event-log regression but fail-opens, allowing approve/catchup/claim to continue after known data loss

Status: todo

Severity: P1

Description:

runOpportunisticMainCheckoutChecks can detect event-log regression/truncation and records warnings, but the caller treats the check as advisory. When breakFlagged is true, the function only returns from the guard/fallback path; approve/catchup/claim continues running against a repo state where the event log is already known to have regressed.

This is unsafe for the recent data-loss incidents: once the guard reports current tip seq lower than mark or content-mismatch, the system must fail closed before any merge, state transition, or retry mutates additional state.

Observed evidence in live repo:

.fgos/logs/main-checkout-guard-warnings.jsonl contains repeated warnings for event shards where current seq/hash regressed from previously marked seq/hash. Despite that, later approve attempts continued and produced raw CAS/merge errors.

Relevant code:

- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: advanceEventsJsonlTruncationGuard detects mismatch/regression.
- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: runOpportunisticMainCheckoutChecks records warning and sets breakFlagged.
- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: when breakFlagged, function returns instead of throwing/reporting a hard failure.
- Callers such as approve/claim/catchup do not receive a typed failure.

Acceptance criteria:

1. When guard detects regression, approve/catchup/claim must stop before mutating work state or running merge.
2. CLI/API result should be structured, e.g. { outcome: "blocked", reason: "event-log-regressed", file, mark, current }.
3. The warning log should still be written, but warning must not be the only effect.
4. Add regression test proving an event shard with prior mark seq/hash higher than current disk content blocks approve before merge.
5. Add regression test proving no moveWork(... awaiting-approval -> blocked/delivered) happens after a guard break.
6. Recovery path should be explicit: operator must restore/reconcile event log, then acknowledge/reset guard mark intentionally.

Related:

- Strongly related to tsk-4uv.
- This item is not the root cause of truncation, but it prevents compounding damage after truncation is detected.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.title: Title: events-jsonl truncation guard sidecar write is unlocked read-modify-write, so concurrent…
payload.description:
Title: events-jsonl truncation guard sidecar write is unlocked read-modify-write, so concurrent sessions can lose guard marks

Status: todo

Severity: P2, potentially P1 if guard is promoted to hard safety gate.

Description:

The truncation guard sidecar is a shared JSON map keyed by event file. writeGuardMark(guardPath, fileKey, mark) reads the whole map, updates one key, then writes the whole map back without any lock or atomic compare. Concurrent sessions advancing marks for different files can overwrite each other's updates.

This does not directly delete event-log entries, but it can make the detector forget the last known-good seq/hash for a file. That weakens or defeats the guard exactly when multiple sessions are active, which is the same operating mode where event loss is being observed.

Relevant code:

- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: readGuardMarks.
- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: writeGuardMarks.
- src/state/events-jsonl-truncation-guard.mjs: writeGuardMark performs unlocked read-modify-write.
- test/runner/concurrent-claim-eventlog-loss.test.mjs: existing test name says it reproduces unlocked guard mark race, but assertion only checks typeof report.ok === 'boolean', so it does not prove marks are preserved.

Acceptance criteria:

1. Guard sidecar updates must be serialized with a lock, or written through an atomic CAS/retry loop.
2. Concurrent writes to marks for different file keys must preserve both keys.
3. Concurrent writes to the same file key must never move the mark backward.
4. Existing weak test should be replaced or strengthened to fail on lost mark updates.
5. Add a deterministic multi-process regression test: two children update different file keys from the same initial sidecar; final sidecar must contain both.
6. If mark write fails or detects conflicting regression, caller must not silently re-bootstrap from current truncated content.

Related:

- Supports tsk-4uv.
- Should be fixed before relying on guard as a hard fail-closed mechanism.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.title: Title: fgos approve failure paths leak raw transitionWork CAS errors instead of structured…
payload.description:
Title: fgos approve failure paths leak raw transitionWork CAS errors instead of structured concurrent-state result

Status: todo

Severity: P2

Description:

Several fgos approve failure paths call moveWork(... expectedStatus: "awaiting-approval") directly after a merge/catchup failure. If another session or prior retry already moved the item back to blocked, or if event replay regressed and makes the item appear blocked, transitionWork throws a raw CAS error:

transitionWork: expected status "awaiting-approval" ... but found "blocked"

That exits as an unclassified crash instead of returning the same structured block envelope used for normal merge failures.

Relevant code:

- src/verbs/merge/approve.mjs: conflict path calls moveWork(... awaiting-approval -> blocked).
- src/verbs/merge/approve.mjs: merge-failed-unclassified path calls same.
- src/verbs/merge/approve.mjs: fgos-write-rejected, lock-lost-mid-merge, verify-fail paths also call direct moveWork.
- src/state/status-fsm.mjs: CAS mismatch throws FsmError('conflict', ...).

Acceptance criteria:

1. Approve must catch CAS mismatch from failure-to-block transitions.
2. Result should be structured, e.g. { outcome: "blocked", reason: "state-changed-concurrently", expected: "awaiting-approval", actual: "blocked" }.
3. It must not mask successful merges that already landed; success-path diagnostic handling remains separate.
4. Add test: approve reads item as awaiting-approval, merge fails, then before failure block write the item is already blocked; approve returns structured result, not exit 3/raw throw.
5. Add test for event-regression replay showing stale actual status also returns structured error.

Related:

- Matches the raw CAS symptom from tsk-3uc.
- Depends conceptually on tsk-4uv/guard fixes, but can be fixed independently for cleaner operator behavior.
- tsk-5rg documents the same live crash text ("transitionWork: expected status \"awaiting-approval\" ... but found \"blocked\" — refusing to overwrite blindly") observed on tsk-3uc, with a suspected root cause in approve's own retry/cleanup path; this item scopes only the narrower fix of catching that CAS mismatch and returning a structured result, independent of tsk-5rg's deeper root-cause investigation.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
